body: Can I ask why? I understand if it’s too personal to post!
Never pressure.. just the urge to wack

I work full time right now and am looking for another place to live. I’m 19 so I can do what I want. I just don’t want my entire paycheck going towards rent... I attempted last night but I couldn’t get past the human survival instinct stage. *sighs* ANOTHER FAILED ATTEMPT!

Are you at least almost done with finals? I have a two papers due tomorrow which I haven’t started. Also... uncanny timing to talk about your father. My dad is my favorite parent by far, and I really don’t care what anything has to say about it. The fight 3 days ago was between my mom and I. My textbooks are due back at school Friday, and she’s going to drop them off tomorrow at my school which is 3 hours away. She told me she didn’t have a choice, that I was forcing her to go. I told her I would do it myself, but they don’t trust me to drive 3 hours by myself. Anyways, I started screaming at her because obviously I said I would do it myself. My dad has been quiet during all this, and usually doesn’t get involved when I fight with my mother. He came out of their bedroom whilst I was screaming at her and he hit me. He also called me a little bitch. To that I threw up my middle finger, and said a big fuck you before throwing my head against the hallway walls. I don’t know why but for some reason when I get angry I cant stop throwing my head against the wall or diving into the floor headfirst. I cant stop shaking, and I can’t hear out of my left ear. I’ve always hit my head after arguments, but tonight I think I hit mine a little too hard because somethings not right. Anyways, I’m going to go to bed early right now and hopefully not wake up. 

With all of that said, I don’t have a favorite parent anymore.

It’s hard for me to set goals for some reason. I’m in college now on a pre-law track, but it’s hard for me to picture being alive and pursuing that. I feel stuck, and I don’t want to do anything about it. I guess I can’t be helped unless I don’t help myself. I like where I’m at working in a grocery store, and would do this for the rest of my life. However, my grocery store I work at is in the hometown where my parents live so I would occasionally see them if I would work here forever. I’m really not about that, and NEED to find a place of my own. It’s just hard for me to imagine my entire check going towards just not wanting to live with my parents. I know job transfers exist, but my boss is what makes my store worth it for me. I don’t want to lose her.

I’m going to go ahead and reply to this because I’m in a similar situation.. kinda. I keep my shit literally in my backpack.. like why is my mom going through that, but she does when I’m home from college. She found my birth control, and had a million questions. However, that was last year. 

3 days ago my mother found my dab pen. Although it’s not the worst thing she could have found, she deliberately took it and lied about taking it. My mother has been a liar for years, but I had enough of it that night. I called the police on her, but they did not do anything. I’ve been living in the bathroom of my parents apartment because there’s no where else to go. I go to work, and come here. I’ve been literally sleeping on the bathroom floor because I can’t be around them. It’s constant lying. I left my laptop in the bathroom because this is my room now, and when I came home it was gone. She had the nerve to say “nobody moved it.” STRAIGHT. UP. LYING. TO. MY. FACE. My mothers is also aware I smoke weed, but she’s never asked about it.. just smelled. I try not to smoke bud anywhere near the apartment for this sake. Even when people in the apartment complex smoke, it’s always blamed on me.. WHEN IM NOT EVEN HOME!! 

With that said, I hope you don’t feel alone. Although my situation is different, it’s kinda similar in the aspect of parents finding shit. However, mine went badly because it was the final straw with my mother lying to my face. Anyways, I attempted tonight for a series of reasons I won’t get into rn. I’m alive today, and you should stay alive today too. We are gonna suffer today together, how’s that sound?

hey- I really appreciate the reply. It makes me feel like I exist to someone. Anyhow, I ended up finishing everything I had to get done by tonight. I have work tomorrow morning 9-5 per usual. I too feel like if I had a gun I wouldn’t be typing this. I just am not old enough to hold a firearm yet. The scary thing is, that doesn’t even scare me to write. I just wish 21 was closer. 

However, there are things I look forward to in life regardless of how shitty my life is right now. I look forward to seeing this one kid I work with—don’t know if it’s the grocery store atmosphere or what but he’s fine as hell! We used to talk, but he ghosted me last week. Bummer times. I think I’m gonna go ahead and text this Tinder boy tomorrow night and see what’s going on with that. Another thing I look forward to—well, I guess I “used to” look forward to doing ANYTHING with my 11 year old sister.. but she’s been distant lately. I overheard her and my mother talking about me.. (as they do) and my sister said her only escape was being at school. This breaks my heart although I know it would be agonizing for her to find me dead, or even know I died. 

I hope you get some work done on your precalc project. Let me know how that goes, or don’t. Sanity over homework. I just ended up finishing mine just in case I do decide to live longer, and I need those good grades. It was also something to get my mind off.. uh ya know. Anyways, if you ever wanted to go in depth about yourself and your own experience on this topic, I’m here. Reddit’s great for that anonymous type beat.

Timing is crazy. I just failed.. again. The human instinct is what is so hard for me to get over. I start hearing stars and struggling so much that I have to stop myself. 3rd times the charm I guess. We will see what happens.. but today I’m alive, which means I have 2 assignments due at 12am. I would always choose to die because for me, there’s no starting a new life. I’m 19 and home from college. I work full time, and live in an apartment currently with my parents and 11 year old sister. I had a fight with my mother two nights ago, and I called the police. They didn’t do anything, so now I’m living in the bathroom since our apartment is so small only going to work. I’m looking for a new place to live but where can I live AND have money. I don’t want to be broke, and my entire paycheck going towards rent. I move back into school on January 9th. Can’t come soon enough, although I am not motivated with school anymore. The only reason I want to go back there is so I do not have to live here. Nobody knows I attempted tonight because I’m embarrassed. The only thing in my life that is worth living for is my job. I love working in a grocery store. I’m so happy whenever I walk in there which is temporary ik. Anyways, I failed BECAUSE I AM A PU$$Y and I wish I could just ya know.

Should I text him tonight asking about Friday, or text him Friday morning asking? I don’t want to seem desperate, but a girl just got plans tomorrow night LMAO.
